messages:
ara: Heads-up — after the model bump to v5.2.1 in staging we saw a sudden p95/p99 jump. Rollout paused.

ci-bot: [regression-detector] perf-regression detected on staging: p99 latency +82ms vs baseline, affected route=generate/text. See link: https://perf.redwood/investigate/3498765432 :warning:

nick: :eyes: Any obvious culprit from profiler? kernel selection or batching?

ara: Initial flame shows kernel scheduler flipping to `slow_attention` for mid-lengths ~180-220 tokens. Also a big increase in KV cache misses (eviction spikes). Token-length distribution shifted because tokenizer now emits more subword splits for emojis/diacritics in v5.2.1.

devon: I ran a quick bisect across the model + runtime changes — the perf delta shows up when both the tokenizer change (model checkpoint) and a scheduler heuristic tweak landed. Bisect points to commit `c9f2b7a` in runtime: changed kernel selector threshold from 256->192 to favor tiled kernels.

ara: Repro script (staging, single-worker):
```bash
python perf_load.py --model v5.2.1 --profile --seq=200 --concurrency=8 --samples=200
kubectl logs -n staging deploy/runtime-profiler | tail -n 200
```

nick: Logs show `kvcache: evict_rate=0.42` during the run. That plus kernel flip = more time in slowpath per token. Maybe the kernel selection metric used avg_seq_len instead of p95; change biased route for the new tokencontours.

devon: Quick workaround: force kernel override to `fast_tiled` for model:v5.2.1 in staging config. Patch: `runtime.kernel_override.v5.2.1 = fast_tiled` — rolling that now to confirm.

runtime-oncall: I'll monitor. If override restores p99, we should back out the heuristic change and open a follow-up to make selector use length quantiles per-tenant.

ops: Filed incident: INC-2026-45. Assigned to devon/nick. Add an eval that includes the new tokenizer edgecases (emoji-heavy).

ara: Agreed. Next steps: (1) keep override until rollback or proper fix, (2) full bisect PR for `c9f2b7a`, (3) add tokenizer-variant tests to CI, (4) add kvcache eviction telemetry to model onboarding checklist.

devon: tl;dr we introduced a scheduling heuristic that didn't consider token-contours -> kernel misroute + kvcache churn. Will open revert PR and a follow-up to change selector to use p95/p99 thresholds. :thumbsup:

nick: Thanks — ping me when rollback PR is up and I'll help validate perf in staging.

ci-bot: [ci] rollback-pr #4237 created by devon referencing INC-2026-45. Perf job queued.
